errorRules.message: Invalid or missing ModelScope access token (HTTP 401). Check {apiKeyEnvVar}. Get one at {setupUrl}

instructions: 1. Visit: https://modelscope.cn/home and register or log in with the "Log in/Register" button in the top right corner (https://modelscope.cn/docs/accounts/registration)

2. Bind an Alibaba Cloud account and complete real-name verification: "After account registration, you must bind your Alibaba Cloud account and complete real-name verification before using API-Inference." (https://modelscope.cn/docs/model-service/API-Inference/intro; binding steps: https://modelscope.cn/docs/accounts/aliyun-binding-and-authorization)
3. Create an access token at https://modelscope.cn/my/myaccesstoken; the token guide (https://modelscope.cn/docs/accounts/token) has you specify a validity period, "Long-term use" or "Short-term use"

4. Free for registered users: "API-Inference is provided free of charge to registered ModelScope users." (intro page); the limits page (https://modelscope.cn/docs/model-service/API-Inference/limits) states that API Inference "implements certain limits on usage quotas and concurrency"
setup.description: OpenAI-compatible endpoint at https://api-inference.modelscope.cn/v1. The intro page (https://modelscope.cn/docs/model-service/API-Inference/intro) says "ModelScope's API-Inference currently provides OpenAI API-compatible interfaces for large language models." and its example sets base_url="https://api-inference.modelscope.cn/v1/". The docs text was read on 2026-09-29 from the raw document files the docs site loads (English build 2026-9-28_15-50-EN, for example https://resouces.modelscope.cn/document/docdata/2026-9-28_15-50-EN/dist/model-service/API-Inference/intro/intro_EN.md; Chinese build 2026-9-28_15-49-CN where noted), because the rendered pages at modelscope.cn are a JavaScript shell. This entry is docs- and roster-verified, not yet live-verified: the model ids come from an unauthenticated GET of https://api-inference.modelscope.cn/v1/models (HTTP 200, 35 models, 2026-09-29) and no API key was used. Each model's task was read on 2026-09-29 from an unauthenticated GET of https://www.modelscope.cn/api/v1/models/<model id> (the Data.Tasks field). capabilities.thinking is true: ModelScope's Codewhale integration page (https://modelscope.cn/docs/ecosystem-integrations/api-usage/codewhale, English build file ecosystem-integrations/api-usage/codewhale/codewhale_EN.md) says "Qwen and GLM series models support `reasoning_content` streaming output". models.defaultContextWindow (32,768) and models.defaultMaxOutputTokens (4,096) are placeholders. errorRules holds one 401 rule taken from an unauthenticated GET of https://api-inference.modelscope.cn/v1/tasks/abc, which answered HTTP 401 with the JSON body {"errors":{"message":"Authentication failed, please make sure that a valid ModelScope token is supplied."},"request_id":"..."}.

rosterVerified.method: unauthenticated GET https://api-inference.modelscope.cn/v1/models — 35 models; credential-free, no key used

authProbe.method: unauthenticated GET https://api-inference.modelscope.cn/v1/tasks/abc (the AIGC task-polling route used in the intro page's example, not chat/completions) — JSON body {"errors":{"message":"Authentication failed, please make sure that a valid ModelScope token is supplied."},"request_id":"..."}; an unauthenticated GET of https://api-inference.modelscope.cn/v1/chat/completions answered HTTP 404 with the plain-text body "404 page not found"; credential-free, no key used

billingProbe.method: public docs pages https://modelscope.cn/docs/model-service/API-Inference/intro ("API-Inference is provided free of charge to registered ModelScope users.") and https://modelscope.cn/docs/model-service/API-Inference/limits ("free of charge"), English text read from the docs site's document files; credential-free
